What is the value of ${b}_{23}+{b}_{33}?$

feedback.problem: Find $B=\overset{―}{A}$, where $A=[\begin{aligned}-3+6\text{i} & 2+7\text{i} \\ 9 & 9-5\text{i}\end{aligned}].$ What is the value of ${b}_{12}+{b}_{22}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Taking the complex conjugate of each entry, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{A} & =\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-3+6\text{i} & 2+7\text{i} \\ 9 & 9-5\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-3+6\text{i}} & \overset{―}{2+7\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{9} & \overset{―}{9-5\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3-6\text{i} & 2-7\text{i} \\ 9 & 9+5\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${b}_{12}+{b}_{22}=(2-7\text{i})+(9+5\text{i})=11-2\text{i}.$
